decidedBy: coordinator (label-x-9d) per user delegation: context-sharing issues are decided by coordinator; only system decisions go to the user
coordinatorAddress: Use ListAgents and pick the session that is not you and not a known worker (names so far: label-x-98 -> label-x-9d). Names can change; if unsure, ask the user.

taskOwnership.rule: one owner per task; never run the same task in two sessions; a new session that continues another session's work must be named as the owner by the coordinator first

owners.integrator worktree /tmp/labelx-m03-inte: read-only for everyone; only the coordinator may assign changes to it

isolation.database: labelx_<session>_<purpose> (e.g. labelx_e2e_claude belongs to label-x-38); never touch another session's DB
isolation.scratchpad: each session uses only its own scratchpad subdirectory (scratchpad/<session>); never write to files in a shared scratchpad path
isolation.processes: kill only processes you started; never kill another session's worker

reporting.to: coordinator via SendMessage; first line a self-contained sentence
reporting.content: task and state; SHA/branch/worktree; real test numbers; issues/blockers/questions with evidence and recommendation; what was not verified
reporting.doNotDo: no push/merge/close issue/assignee change/GitHub; no PASS claim without running; no self-certifying QC of own work; no E2E CVAT PASS claim from fixtures; no token printing

decisionsByCoordinator: which session owns which task and when a session stops
which SHA is the test baseline (currently c4cacec126148c8e68e42ef9843070584fce0c97)
decisionsForUser: push, PR creation, merge, issue closing, assignee changes
CVAT data changes (manual annotation edits), taxonomy, policy values
